decisionChannel: Founder answers to interactive questions in the orchestrator chat, 2026-11-02; each ownerStatement is the option label chosen

decisions.item: Default depth and mode per checkpoint, default profiles and the no-profile baseline

decision.baseline: the currently undocumented practice becomes the documented baseline

decisions.detail: The quick profile remains the pre-commit mode. Profiles are named presets; the exact per-profile tables are defined in T002 and cannot lower a REQ-003 floor.
The never-admitted set is the REQ-003 floors, always human-only.

decisions.item: Maximum expiry horizon and expiry scope
decisions.detail: Same founder answer as Q2; one option covered Q2 and Q3.

decisions.item: Who may issue standing authorizations and the form of the verbatim statement

decision.statementForm: verbatim founder statement stored in a hashed JSON record

decisions.detail: No delegate. One option covered Q4, Q5 and Q6.

decision.sensitivePaths: validate_change sensitive classification raises pre-pr-review to R3
decision.sizeRule: a diff over 400 changed lines raises to R3
decision.sharedFileRule: a diff touching any shared file raises to R3

decisions.detail: The classifier can only raise depth or mode, never lower either.

decisions.item: Depth semantics beyond the review ladder
decisions.detail: Other checkpoint families (for example plan-tasks, ci) get their own depth definitions only through a later decision.

limits: Records founder choices for SPEC-067 only. Nothing here implements a profile, issues a standing authorization, or authorizes any execution, merge or release; the REQ-003 floors stay human-only. Owner statements are the option labels chosen in the 2026-11-02 interactive questions. Per-profile tables, exact receipts and the compiled artifact are defined by T002 to T006. Any change needs a new founder decision record.
